other_conditions: Applicant must be a working woman.
If residing in Chennai, monthly income must not exceed ₹25,000.
If residing in any other district of Tamil Nadu, monthly income must not exceed ₹15,000.
benefits_summary: Provides affordable rent of ₹300 per month in Chennai and ₹200 per month in other districts, along with safe accommodation, food, and electricity for up to 3 years.
